reviews.blind_recognition: Not independent; creator already knew brief. Unlabeled inspection: Hand presenting a grocery box; high confidence food support.
reviews.assessment: Palm contacts the box underside, thumb lies over the lower front, four fingers form one supporting group. Teal cuff and peach hand stay separate from the ochre box; no arrow. Clear rectangular box versus accepted blue rescue basket.
limitations: At 16 px the produce reduces to a few color patches; hand and grocery box remain useful.

reviews.blind_recognition: Not independent; creator already knew brief. Unlabeled inspection: Clapperboard with speech bubble; high confidence film plus discussion.
reviews.assessment: Sloped striped clapstick has a plausible left pivot, play symbol stays left of the large attached bubble. Bubble tail and clapper silhouette survive small renderings.
limitations: Three conversation dots soften at 16 px; the film-plus-discussion silhouette survives.

reviews.blind_recognition: Not independent; creator already knew brief. Unlabeled inspection: Welding helmet, torch and spark at a metal seam; high confidence.
reviews.assessment: Helmet visor is enclosed; torch handle joins bent nozzle and wire touches the metal joint. Metal ledge and spark remain separate. Object-only composition avoids unsupported body anatomy.
limitations: Fine seam detail softens at 16 px; helmet and spark distinguish this from electronics soldering.

reviews.blind_recognition: Not independent; creator already knew brief. Unlabeled inspection: Open flatbed fabrication machine with cutting head; moderate-to-high confidence laser cutter.
reviews.assessment: Windowed lid, open chamber, gantry-mounted head and short beam touching the work sheet are connected. Feet and panel have balanced margins; no blade or extrusion spool.
limitations: At 16 px this reads as a flatbed machine; exact laser technology is clearest at 24/32 px.

reviews.blind_recognition: Not independent; creator already knew brief. Unlabeled inspection: Two pastel filled sandwich cookies; high confidence macarons.
reviews.assessment: Smooth rounded shells, ruffled feet and light filling distinguish macarons from plain biscuits. Matching upper-left highlights, coherent overlap, unclipped edges and broad filling gap.
limitations: Shell feet simplify at 16 px; two pastel sandwich cookies remain clear.

reviews.blind_recognition: Not independent; creator already knew brief. Unlabeled inspection: Two film frames showing a clay figure changing pose; moderate-to-high confidence animation.
reviews.assessment: Both figures use the same short connected body and balanced legs, with feet grounded on the scene bottom. Arm pose changes between sequential frames. Perforated film border separates this from plain portraits.
limitations: At 16 px the individual pose change is subtle and can read as generic animation; film sequence remains useful. No claim of independent blind recognition.
